## Findings
<a id="findings"></a>

- <a id="research.backend-src-common-dto.d70f62b4"></a>**1. The unit backend/src/common/dto contains a single source file, error-response.dto.ts, which defines and exports the ErrorResponseDto class.**
  [`error-response.dto.ts:1-33`](../error-response.dto.ts#L1-L33)
- <a id="research.backend-src-common-dto.3dc17d40"></a>**2. ErrorResponseDto declares three required properties — statusCode (number), message (string), and timestamp (string) — each documented with the @ApiProperty decorator imported from @nestjs/swagger.**
  [`error-response.dto.ts:1-1`](../error-response.dto.ts#L1-L1)
  [`error-response.dto.ts:4-20`](../error-response.dto.ts#L4-L20)
- <a id="research.backend-src-common-dto.de431570"></a>**3. ErrorResponseDto declares two optional properties — path (string) and details (string) — each documented with the @ApiPropertyOptional decorator imported from @nestjs/swagger.**

  [`error-response.dto.ts:22-32`](../error-response.dto.ts#L22-L32)
